video_title: 專訪Kyrie Irving！第一個打爆Kyrie的人是誰？生涯的第15個賽季，Kyrie在場上最大的變化是什麼？【Telfair的球員專訪】

quotes.speaker: Kyrie Irving
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving on the importance of earning respect from teammates
quotes.excerpt: I had to go earn my respect.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: Could you give me your best Kevin Boyle story?

text_blocks.speaker: Kyrie Irving
text_blocks.text: When I first transferred in, he did not really know what to expect. He did not really know what I was about skill-wise. My dad had advocated for me, but it was about me showing him and earning the respect of not only him but my teammates and all my peers that went to that school. Going to St. Patrick from Montclair Kimberley Academy really put my dream at the top of my priority list every day. I had to go earn my respect.

quotes.speaker: Kyrie Irving
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving on his preference for complex dribbling combinations
quotes.excerpt: Anything that incorporates combinations where one simple move can lead to three, four, five, six combinations.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: Do you have your favorite move?

text_blocks.speaker: Kyrie Irving
text_blocks.text: Anything that incorporates combinations where one simple move can lead to three, four, five, six combinations. That is the best part about it.

quotes.speaker: Kyrie Irving
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving recalls Jose Calderon's breakout performance against him
quotes.excerpt: Jose Calderon bust my ass. He gave me 26 and 14.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: Who was the first person to bust your ass?

text_blocks.speaker: Kyrie Irving
text_blocks.text: In Cleveland, Jose Calderon bust my ass. He gave me 26 and 14. He was celebrating like a motherfucker. I was sick. I had 6 and 6 that night. I was like, yo, this motherfucker. And I swear to you to this day, shout out to my man Jose Calderon now, because he knows I will dog him.

quotes.speaker: Kyrie Irving
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving on the hard work required to remain an elite player
quotes.excerpt: You can't fake being an NBA player. You have to go get shots up.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: What has been changed the most about your on-court performance?

text_blocks.speaker: Kyrie Irving
text_blocks.text: I just want to be a complete player, be able to do it on both ends of the floor, be in the best condition that I can be in, and have fun doing what I love to do. This is the 0.1% or 0.01% of the world, and it is a lot of hard work. You cannot fake being an NBA player. You have to go get shots up. You have to sacrifice a lot of your time to be in the gym. You have to do the little things that are not the prettiest. A lot of unseen hours is really what I am referring to. You have to train your body, you have to train your mind, and you are making so many quick decisions out there. We live in a very analytical world right now where people are just basing things off the stats, so you have to just be aware of how the NBA game has grown and I feel like I have grown with it.
